QUOTE: "**Schema and code staleness are never auto-refreshed.** ... For a code notice, the caller restarts the MCP client so the process loads the current code, then calls `index(action='refresh', force=True)`." and "**schema:** ... A rebuild re-stamps the same newer version, so it cannot clear this."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes different remedies per axis (rebuild for data, restart for code) but never explains that the differing remedies are the reason for having separate axes rather than one flag.
